create_TransformingConsumer: create a TransformingConsumer that applies a transformation function before passing values to a downstream consumer
build_IterableConsumer: build an IterableConsumer that buffers consumed values and allows iteration over them in a thread-safe manner
create_ThreadSwitchingConsumer: create a ThreadSwitchingConsumer that serializes consumption and switches to a thread pool for async processing
test_IterableConsumer_next: test the IterableConsumer next method to verify it blocks until a value is consumed then returns it
review_ThreadSwitchingConsumer_spin: review the ThreadSwitchingConsumer _spin method to understand how it drains queued values from the sink
